content.introduction: The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items in U.S. City Average (CPIAUCSL) is a price index of a basket of goods and services paid by urban consumers. As of July 2026, the index stood at 332.813, up from 332.568 in June 2026 and 333.979 in May 2026. The index measures inflation rate between any two time periods, with the most common metric being the percent change from one year ago. It represents the buying habits of urban consumers, covering roughly 88 percent of the total population, including wage earners and clerical workers.
